bodyHtml:
On Saturday, April 13 the Spins participated in The Viking Classic 7v7 Tournament hosted by the Hudson Valley Community College Men's Soccer Team.

Spindles joined local colleges in a friendly, Dutch-style tournament with no shortness of competition.

HVCC, SUNY Cobleskill, SUNY Adirondack, and Ulster Community College were the schools competing

The Spins entered 2 teams in the tournament.

Despite the lack of cooperation from the weather, the event was still a great success to be a part of.

Plenty of goals, celebrations, smiles, and urges to leave due to the sideways rain made for a great unofficial kickoff to the 2024 season.

Spindles United White finished in 2nd place, and Spindles United Red finished in 4th overall out of 8 teams.

With preseason less than 2 weeks away, the Spins are eager to get the new year underway.

A special thank you to HVCC Head Coach Devon Thomson and Assistant Coach Boulos Abdallah for inviting us!
